title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. X is presumably D_0 = the Deligne–Mumford compactification of M_{g,ν}, regarded as a stack or orbifold. It carries the boundary filtration by closed strata D_d, the curves with at least d nodes, and D*_d denotes the corresponding open strata. For admissible closed parts Σ' ⊂ Σ'' of X (and an auxiliary Σ), Grothendieck uses V_{Σ',Σ''} for the 'type', i.e. the homotopy type or topos, of a tubular neighbourhood of Σ' in Σ''. V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} is the variant with Σ removed, essentially the neighbourhood type with Σ'∩Σ deleted.

Previous page. Grothendieck reduces two kinds of type to simpler ones:
- type (258) reduces to type (257) by passing to complements X∖Σ_0;
- V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} reduces to the case Σ'' = X.

This page. At the topos level it suffices 'in principle' to make explicit two things:
1. the types V_{Σ',Σ''};
2. the transition morphisms (259) V_{Σ',Σ''} → V_{Σ'_1,Σ''_1} for inclusions of pairs (Σ',Σ'') ⊂ (Σ'_1,Σ''_1).

The 'starred' variants come from applying the same formalism to X∖Σ_0^ξ etc. The relative types V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} then appear as open sub-types of V_{Σ',Σ''}. They are complementary to the closed immersion V_{Σ'∩Σ,Σ''} → V_{Σ',Σ''}. This is an open/closed (recollement) decomposition of toposes.

Grothendieck warns that this 'évidence' does not translate easily to the level of fundamental groupoids. Removing a closed piece changes π_1 in a non-explicit way, by adding loops around the removed piece.

Guiding principle of the 'petit programme'. All homotopy types attached to the filtration, and in particular their π_1, should be made explicit in terms of a small generating family:
- types attached to flags d_0 > … > d_r ≥ 0 of boundary depths;
- namely V_{d_*} := V_{D*_{d_*}, D_0} and a starred (deleted) version V*_{d_*};
- together with the natural morphisms between these.

The next page stresses that these are tubular neighbourhoods of the open strata D*_{d_*}, not of the closed D_{d_*}. It also extends the family to pairs of flags d'_* ⊂ d_*.

In modern terms, the aim is a combinatorial description of the stratified homotopy type of M̄_{g,ν}: a diagram of homotopy links and deleted tubular neighbourhoods indexed by flags of strata. This is the input data for a dévissage of the Teichmüller tower 'at infinity'.
errors: No mathematical error. The open/closed decomposition at topos level is correct. Grothendieck himself correctly flags that it does not yield a direct description at the π_1 level. The two defining formulas at the bottom of the page are ambiguous in the image: which of V and V* carries the star, and whether D or D* appears.

ideas.what: Encode a stratified space by the system of tubular-neighbourhood types V_{Σ',Σ''} of strata pairs plus transition maps for inclusions of pairs
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy links / exit-path ∞-category or link diagram of a stratified space
ideas.usually_credited_to: Quinn (homotopy links, 1988); MacPherson, Treumann (exit-path 2-categories, 2009); Lurie (Higher Algebra, App. A); Ayala–Francis–Tanaka
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 (dévissage of stratified structures, tubular neighbourhoods, 'structure à l'infini' of M_{g,ν}), in outline only

ideas.what: Deleted relative neighbourhood type V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} as the open subtopos complementary to the closed immersion V_{Σ'∩Σ,Σ''} → V_{Σ',Σ''}
Program: express all homotopy types and π_1's attached to the boundary filtration of M̄_{g,ν} via tubular neighbourhoods of open strata D*_{d_0..d_r} relative to D_0, and the maps between them
ideas.modern_name: Stratified homotopy type of the Deligne–Mumford boundary; 'tangential base points' and the Teichmüller tower at infinity
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (tower of Teichmüller groupoids, infinity structure), in outline

missed.claim: Grothendieck observes that the open/closed decomposition of neighbourhood types, obvious at topos level, does not translate explicitly into fundamental-groupoid data. He leaves open how to compute π_1 of the deleted types V^Σ from the undeleted ones. This is an explicit gap in his programme for a groupoid-level dévissage of M̄_{g,ν}.
missed.quote: Mais cette "évidence" ne s'explicite pas aisément, au niveau des groupoïdes fondamentaux...
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Exit-path ∞-categories solve this at the ∞-level. An explicit 1-truncated (Teichmüller-groupoid) recipe for the Knudsen–DM boundary, compatible with Galois actions, is still only partially available (e.g. via Nakamura's work on the boundary of Teichmüller groupoids).

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working sketch of the stratified-homotopy dévissage already announced in the Esquisse. It is more concrete about the indexing by flags of boundary depths and the use of open strata. It contains no finished result absent from the literature, and it was later realised by exit-path/homotopy-link theory.
transcription_corrections: 'savoir capturer' is more likely 'savoir expliciter' (consistent with the surrounding vocabulary).

'on trouve dans les V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} comme ses types…' is better read as 'on trouve les V^Σ_{Σ',Σ''} comme des types ouverts de V_{Σ',Σ''} (complémentaires de) l'immersion fermée V_{Σ'∩Σ,Σ''} → V_{Σ',Σ''}'. The struck word is probably 'résiduels', with 'ouverts de V_{Σ';Σ''}' inserted above it.
'(comme ceux qui sont d'explicitation)' is probably '(ou ceux qui sont dignes d'explicitation)' or similar.
'D_0 g et' is 'D_0, et'. The two defining formulas are respectively an unstarred and a starred type, both built on D*_{d_0..d_r} relative to D_0, as confirmed by the next page.
